rows.label: tlk70000072_01_msg0001
rows.name:
Morumo supported everyone in the
shopping district day and night, mo.
No wonder Morumo's popular, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000072_01_msg0002
rows.name:
A little too much power, mo. And a
little too much showing off, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000072_01_msg0003
rows.name:
Trying too hard hurts, mo. Admitting
it hurts too, so at some point you
start acting foolish, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000072_01_msg0004
rows.name:
Makumaku thinks people are
probably just right when
they're a little uncool, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000072_01_msg0005
rows.name:
So what Morumo needs now isn't money,
mo.

rows.label: tlk70000072_01_msg0006
rows.name:
Somewhere to let true feelings and
weaknesses spill out, and someone to
give a good spanking, mo!

rows.label: tlk70000072_01_msg0101
rows.name:
What happened to the Red Pollen Orbs,
mo? Fine if you left them, but selling
any you picked up is the worst, mo!
